items.statement_en: Because the memory objects are generated by the agent itself from prior interactions, the datastore is agent-curated context rather than an externally sourced database the agent merely reads.
evidence_quotes: external data sources that have not been curated by the agent based on interactions with a user may still lack sufficient context for seamlessly supporting future interactions with the user

items.statement_en: Storing memories in the native modality of the interaction is meant to preserve contextual signals such as tone or visual environment that a transcription or caption would discard.
evidence_quotes: The original data modalities of each interaction can encode contextual signals that may be lost if transformed into a different data modality.

items.statement_en: Keeping a support record inside each memory object lets a contradicting input refine a memory into a more nuanced one instead of simply overwriting or deleting it.
evidence_quotes: When a new memory appears to contradict a prior memory, the support record can be used to generate more nuanced memories that can reconcile the memory record.

items.statement_en: The same conversational channel that creates memories is also the channel for erasing or time-limiting them, so user control over retention needs no separate settings surface.
evidence_quotes: the user can also use the same interaction mechanism to limit, erase, or otherwise modify the memory of the machine-learned agent system

items.statement_en: Pre-processing interactions into compact memory objects offline shifts work away from runtime inference, so the model consumes condensed context rather than a full transcript.
evidence_quotes: the system can respond by processing concise, relevant information instead of large amounts of raw data

items.statement_en: Writing new memories without first reading existing ones is cheaper and avoids propagating consolidation errors, at the cost of pushing conflict resolution to query time.
evidence_quotes: it can avoid propagating any intermediate errors in

items.statement_en: Ordering recalled memory values by timestamp is intended to let the sequence model favor the most recent statement when memories conflict.
evidence_quotes: This ordering allows the machine-learned agent system to prioritize more recent context when making inferences.

items.statement_en: Gradual forgetting degrades the richest modalities first, replacing video with frames, frames with one image, and the image with a text summary, while text memories decay more slowly.
evidence_quotes: video data in a memory object can be deleted and replaced with image frames sampled from the video data

items.statement_en: Emitting an API call that assigns a configuration parameter lets the agent answer recurring prompts such as web consent pop-ups from stored preferences without a synchronous user interaction.
evidence_quotes: the task can be completed without initiating a synchronous interaction event at the time of the task performance

items.statement_en: Multi-turn self-deliberation over the query and memory data produces analysis that conditions the final answer but is kept out of the user-facing response.
evidence_quotes: The raw outputs may not be surfaced to the user.

items.statement_en: The independent claim's core loop is retrieval-conditioned prompting: recalled memory data is placed into the model prompt alongside the query, so the novelty asserted lies in how the memory is built and curated rather than in the inference step itself.
evidence_quotes: The prompt can include memory data 114 and all or part of query 104.

items.background_problem: Agents without memory force users to re-enter the same details across sessions and interrupt them with follow-up prompts, while wiring the agent to external data sources offers only an all-or-nothing access choice and context the agent does not control.
items.asserted_effect: The specification asserts that an agent-curated, dynamically updated interaction memory reduces the number and timing of user interactions, enables asynchronous execution of previously instructed tasks, lowers runtime computational load through pre-processed memory objects, and gives users finer control over what is retained.
items.delta: The structural difference claimed is that memory objects are generated, updated, consolidated, and forgotten by the agent from its own interactions with the user, in native modalities and with support records and timestamps, rather than being fetched from uncurated external sources; no performance figures are given.
quotes: Without a memory of useful context, traditional agent devices may require entry of the same information multiple times over the same or multiple sessions in order to perform the same or similar tasks.
the user may be faced with an all-or-nothing choice, which may be undesirable in some circumstances
Example machine-learned agent systems can reduce a number and timing of user interactions to perform a task.

items.what_it_shows_en: Overall agent architecture: query 104 from input interfaces 102 drives a recall cycle 106 against interaction memory datastore 110, yielding memory data 114 that is packed into input data structure 116 for model system 118, whose output 120 becomes response 122 at output interfaces 124.
Internal structure of interaction memory datastore 110 as memory objects 202-1 through 202-M, each holding memory values 204 and memory metadata 206.
An example recall cycle in which input 300 retrieves three JSON memory objects 302, 304, and 306 that are concatenated into memory data 308.
Creation of a new memory object 402 from an input, with an inferred memory value, tags, a support object, and a confidence value.
Updating prior memory object 402 into updated memory object 502 in view of a new input 500, refining the memory value, confidence, and support record.
Communication sequence in which triggers 702 start a memory update cycle 704 that precedes a later query, recall cycle, and model inference rounds.
A memory update cycle in which cached inputs 802 are analyzed by model system 118 to produce memory data updates 804 that are written to datastore 110 via memory data write 806.
A maintenance-style memory update cycle where memory update requests 1002 and current memory data 904 are sent to the model system to generate updates 804 for pruning or consolidating memories.
Networked computing environment with computing device 50 and server computing system 60, each holding processors, memory, data, and instructions, connected over network 49.
